messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — we have a late-window flip at 23:45 PST for a tiny header-routing change. This requires pins on runtime, router, API, and console. Can the folks owning console/router confirm they can ack within the quiet window?
Kevin: I can be on the router/runtime pin. What's the exact pin command you want me to run?
Anna: Use deploybot pin to avoid drift. Example:```
deploybot pin --service runtime --version v3.1.0 --reason "header-routing-safeflip" --until 2026-03-30T00:30:00Z
```And for the router canary:```
deploybot canary --service router --patch header-swap --percent 10 --watch 2m
```
Sam: Okay. Proposal for rollback criteria: abort and roll back if any of the following within the 2m watch window for each step:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute increase over baseline
- p95 latency > +200ms over baseline
- error budget burn > 20% within 2m
Agree?
Linda: +1 to those numbers. Also require ops-oncall to acknowledge the step before moving to next pin. I'll post the short playbook in release-notes channel.
Kevin: Plan: pin runtime -> router canary -> api pin -> console pin. I'll wait for DeployBot ack and a green watch signal before continuing. 2m observation between steps, escalate to oncall if any metric crosses thresholds.
Anna: Small documentation checklist: update internal release notes with version pins and rollback triggers, add a line for customer-facing release notes if console pin remains. I'll handle that after the final pin.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Applying pin: runtime v3.1.0 — requested by Kevin. Status: PENDING.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Pin applied: runtime v3.1.0 — SUCCESS. Observability: no anomalies in initial 2m.
Kevin: Router canary kicked at 23:47. Using 10% header-swap patch. Watching metrics now.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Canary update: router header-swap 10% — WATCHING (2m).
Sam: Early signal: p95 +30ms, 5xx steady. Continuing.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Canary WATCH complete: NO REGRESSION detected.
Kevin: Pinned router and then API. Console owner, you good to pin?
Linda: Console pinned. All pins applied. Playbook updated and message sent to #release-notes-internal.
Anna: Nice. Post-mortem note: if any downstream caching issues show up in next 30m we treat as soft rollback candidate. Marking this "succeeded with monitoring". :thumbsup:
Kevin: Agree. I'll leave a follow-up check at +15m and +30m. @DeployBot log the rollout summary.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Rollout summary: runtime:v3.1.0 pinned, router:header-swap canary 10% -> promoted, api:v2.4.1 pinned, console:v1.9.3 pinned. No automated rollback triggered. Logged by Kevin.
Anna: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — please reopen if anything odd pops up.
